kind: Serial integrated fresh-recall and finalization guard comparison

host.isolation: No concurrent local build/measurement; shared-host tenants uncontrolled

work_clock: Complete serial row helper calls and ordered result-vector allocation/collection; destruction and proof construction outside timers
included_phases: prepared attention, familiarity, selection/hysteresis, routing and novelty
fresh routed recall and cognitive context
projection, finalization and retained public finalized guards
pure CPU perception/memory/cognitive upload encoding and binding
excluded_phases: sleep, learning retry, semantic hints and resident mutations
sealing, save I/O, lifecycle and rendering
proof_scope: Each timed output equals a complete typed same-process reference; all serialized input and core-result/payload hashes match across sources/processes. Host-only upload binding/digest/offset metadata is excluded from the cross-process serialized digest but included in same-process typed equality and derives from identical frame/slot fixtures. Slot fixtures use the same hashed asset, N512 class, indices, generation and 54-lane stride. Banks/topologies remain unchanged.
sampling_scope: Two process pairs; nine samples per process/case; pooled medians average the middle two of 18. No confidence interval or gameplay throughput guarantee.
memory_scope: Process RSS and cumulative high-water samples include fixtures, retained reference/output, allocator/proof history; not fresh stage peaks or evidence of memory savings.
fixtures: Distinct owners 811 onward; 2/26 candidates, actual 0/64/256 retained records, 8/16/32/50 owners; two objects, one concept/gap, fixed valid receptors, default predictor/hysteresis, focal capacity one; no live residents or device
library_identity_scope: Library hashes identify emitted build-time bytes; executables/manifests were preserved before shared output changed. After libraries use an isolated target; shared-target reuse was rejected before timing. Reproduce with separate target directories for both sources.
production_threading: Unimplemented; generated probe has no std::thread calls
